subject.title: [Data] Quality signals for ClawHub Skills — we analyzed the top 50 and found trust gaps

question: Should ClawHub add public multidimensional skill-quality signals, and which dimensions should be advisory versus allowed to affect ranking, visibility, or install guidance?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow code repair; it decides scoring authority, public semantics, data handling, freshness, appeal paths, and separation from security/moderation verdicts.

options.title: Define advisory model first
options.body: Keep this open as product/security design work, specify advisory-only dimensions and provenance, then implement the storage and UI surfaces afterward.

options.title: Fold into external-tool discussion
options.body: Treat the related external quality-tool proposal as the canonical implementation path if maintainers want a third-party evaluator to own the first scoring model.

options.title: Defer public scoring
options.body: Keep current security audits and publish-time quality holds only, and close or park public quality scoring until there is stronger maintainer demand.

recommendation.title: Define advisory model first
recommendation.body: Keep this open as product/security design work, specify advisory-only dimensions and provenance, then implement the storage and UI surfaces afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is CODEOWNERS-listed on the backend/security surfaces and current quality-gate history most directly involved in this decision.
